documents.title: Vendor due diligence summary
documents.text:
Vendor due diligence summary: Castellan Logistics (fictional, authored test material).
Castellan Logistics had employees of 355 in FY2024. For Castellan Logistics, integration savings in FY2024 was €57.6m (reported basis). Run-rate EBITDA at Castellan Logistics stood at €72.3m in the twelve months to 31 Mar 2025 (reported basis). Castellan Logistics had pension deficit of €77.9m in FY2025 (reported basis).

documents.title: Management presentation
documents.text:
Management presentation: Castellan Logistics (fictional, authored test material).
Castellan Logistics trades under the name Bluefin. Bluefin had employees of 399 in FY2024. For Castellan Logistics, cost synergies in FY2024 was €48.4m (reported basis). Order backlog at Castellan Logistics stood at NZD 565.8m in FY2025 (reported basis). Castellan Ltd had net revenue retention of 66.6% in FY2024. Throughout the documents of this review, "integration savings" means the same measure as cost synergies.

documents.title: Buyer quality-of-earnings memo
documents.text:
Buyer quality-of-earnings memo: Castellan Logistics (fictional, authored test material).
Castellan Logistics has a financial year ending on 31 March; FY2025 is the year ended 31 March 2025. Castellan Logistics had run-rate EBITDA of €87.5m in FY2025 (reported basis). For Castellan Logistics, pension deficit in FY2025 was EUR 92.4 million (reported basis). Order backlog at Castellan Logistics stood at NZD 683.2 million in FY2025 (reported basis). Castellan Limited had net revenue retention of 90.8% in FY2024.
